scanNote:
13-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (96-bet) - INFINITIV / -ING.

Yuqorida chapda KO'K yorliqda oq '13' va 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Infinitive - Gerund (-ing form)'.
17) 'Study the examples. Which sentences include: to-infinitive; -ing form; infinitive without to?' 1 While I was in Japan, I decided TO GO to the famous Hamamatsu Kite Festival. 2 They wanted TO JOIN in the fun. 3 I will definitely GO there again. 4 I enjoyed WALKING around the city centre. 5 I couldn't help ADMIRING the view. 6 It made me FEEL sad.
18) 'Look at the table, then read sentences 1 - 10 and put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.' KO'K-YaShIL JADVAL: '+ to-infinitive': decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop (stop briefly to do sth else), remember (not forget), refuse, agree, expect, forget (not remember). '-ing form': love, like, hate, don't mind, look forward to, enjoy, couldn't help, can't stand, stop (finish, give up), remember (recall), forget (not recall). 'infinitive without to': make, let, can, must, may, could, will, would.
   1 Oh no! I forgot ...... (send) Aunt Mary a birthday card. 2 The clowns made the children ...... (laugh) with their tricks. 3 They enjoyed ...... (watch) the parades during the festival. 4 She can't stand ...... (listen) to rock music. 5 Will Dad let us ...... (go) to the party? 6 I like ...... (play) tricks on people on April Fools' Day. 7 I would like ...... (go) to the Hamamatsu Kite Festival. 8 Josh wants ...... (buy) his mother some flowers for Mother's Day. 9 We decided ...... (stay up) and watch the firework display. 10 I'm really looking forward to ...... (go) to Bill's birthday party.

O'NG USTUN:
19) 'Use phrases from the list, together with the prompts below, to act out dialogues in pairs, as in the example.' Qiya: 'watch parades, dance to traditional music, watch firework displays, wear fancy-dress costumes, listen to loud music, go to parties, stay up all night, fly kites, send cards, give presents, play party games, visit exhibitions, listen to rock music, eat traditional food, sing traditional songs, celebrate with friends'. QUTI: love ♥♥♥ / enjoy ♥♥ / like ♥ | don't mind 0 | don't like ✗ / can't stand ✗✗ / hate ✗✗✗. Ko'k qiya: 'SA: Do you like watching parades? SB: Yes, I do. Actually, I love watching parades. Do you like dancing to traditional music? SA: No, I don't. I can't stand dancing to traditional music!'
20) 'Read the short texts and replace the adjectives in bold with similar ones from each list.' Qiya: 'playful, annual, generous, happy, amusing'. A (surat: Krakov festival ishtirokchisi ot kostyumida): 'At the 1) YEARLY Hobby Horse Pageant in Cracow, Poland, we followed the procession of men dressed up as Tartar warriors as they moved slowly towards the Market Square. On his way, the leader of the procession collected money and rewarded 2) KIND donors with a 3) FRIENDLY punch on the arm. He also stopped a few times to perform 4) FUNNY dances for the hundreds of 5) SMILING spectators.' Qiya: 'exciting, delicious, noisy, grateful, exhausted'. B (surat: sharlar): 'My parents organised a party for my tenth birthday. It was great fun. My mother had cooked lots of 1) TASTY food and we played some 2) THRILLING party games. My friends and I were a bit 3) LOUD, but my parents didn't mind. At the end of the party I felt 4) TIRED, but I was also very 5) THANKFUL that my parents had put on such a great party for me.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '96'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples. Which sentences include: to-infinitive; -ing form; infinitive without to?
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing. Qaysi gaplarda: to-infinitiv; -ing shakli; 'to'siz infinitiv bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh ShAKL:

  TO-INFINITIV: to go, to join
    (1, 2) - decide, want dan keyin
  -ING ShAKLI: walking, admiring
    (4, 5) - enjoy, couldn't help
    dan keyin
  'TO'SIZ INFINITIV: go, feel
    (3, 6) - will, make dan keyin


⚠ 'GERUND':

  = gerundiy (-ing shaklidagi
  fe'l-ot). 'walking' = yurish.


⚠ 'DEFINITELY':

  = albatta, aniq.

exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV yoki -ING? - JADVAL.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + TO-INFINITIV                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  decide, want, would like, would
  love, begin, refuse, agree,
  expect
  stop (to do sth else) = boshqa
    ish qilish uchun to'xtamoq
  remember (not forget) = unutmaslik
  forget (not remember) = qilishni
    unutmoq

  'I decided TO GO.'
  'I would like TO VISIT.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + -ING ShAKLI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  love, like, hate, don't mind,
  look forward to, enjoy, couldn't
  help, can't stand
  stop (finish, give up) = tashlamoq
  remember (recall) = eslamoq
  forget (not recall) = eslamaslik

  'I enjoy WALKING.'
  'I'm looking forward to SEEING
   you.' ⚠ 'to' dan keyin -ing!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + 'TO'SIZ INFINITIV             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  make, let, can, must, may, could,
  will, would

  'She made me LAUGH.'
  'Let me GO.'
  'I can SWIM.'


⚠ STOP - IKKI MA'NO:

  stop TO smoke = chekish uchun
    to'xtadi
  stop SMOKING = chekishni tashladi


⚠ REMEMBER - IKKI MA'NO:

  remember TO lock = qulflashni
    unutma
  remember LOCKING = qulflaganimni
    eslayman


⚠ FORGET - IKKI MA'NO:

  forgot TO send = yuborishni
    unutdim (yubormadim)
  forgot SENDING = yuborganimni
    unutdim (yuborgan edim)


⚠ 'TO REFUSE':

  = rad etmoq.


⚠ 'TO EXPECT':

  = kutmoq.

points.en: + to-infinitive: decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop (stop briefly to do sth else), remember (not forget), refuse, agree, expect, forget (not remember)
points.uz: + to-infinitiv: decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop (boshqa ish uchun to'xtamoq), remember (unutmaslik), refuse, agree, expect, forget (qilishni unutmoq)

points.en: -ing form: love, like, hate, don't mind, look forward to, enjoy, couldn't help, can't stand, stop (finish, give up), remember (recall), forget (not recall)
points.uz: -ing shakli: love, like, hate, don't mind, look forward to, enjoy, couldn't help, can't stand, stop (tashlamoq), remember (eslamoq), forget (eslamaslik)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then read sentences 1 - 10 and put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, keyin 1-10 gaplarni o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 to send (forgot = unutdim -
    yubormadim)
  2 laugh (made + to'siz)
  3 watching (enjoyed + -ing)
  4 listening (can't stand + -ing)
  5 go (let + to'siz)
  6 playing (like + -ing)
  7 to go (would like + to)
  8 to buy (wants + to)
  9 to stay up (decided + to)
  10 going (looking forward TO +
     -ing!)


⚠ 'LOOK FORWARD TO + -ING':

  Bu yerda 'to' - predlog, infinitiv
  belgisi emas! Shuning uchun -ing.


⚠ 'A CLOWN':

  = masxaraboz.


⚠ 'TO PLAY TRICKS ON':

  = hazil qilmoq, aldamoq.


⚠ 'APRIL FOOLS' DAY':

  = 1-aprel (hazil kuni).


⚠ 'TO STAY UP':

  = uxlamay o'tirmoq (kech).


⚠ 'A FIREWORK DISPLAY':

  = mushakbozlik.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi iboralar va quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib juftlikda dialoglarni o'ynang, namunadagidek. love ♥♥♥ / enjoy ♥♥ / like ♥ / don't mind / don't like ✗ / can't stand ✗✗ / hate ✗✗✗.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Do you like watching parades?
  SB: Yes, I do. Actually, I love
      watching parades. Do you like
      dancing to traditional music?
  SA: No, I don't. I can't stand
      dancing to traditional music!


YoQISh DARAJALARI:

  love ♥♥♥ = juda yaxshi ko'raman
  enjoy ♥♥ = yoqadi (zavq)
  like ♥ = yoqadi
  don't mind 0 = qarshi emasman
  don't like ✗ = yoqmaydi
  can't stand ✗✗ = toqat qila
    olmayman
  hate ✗✗✗ = yomon ko'raman

  ⚠ HAMMASI + -ING!


⚠ 'A PARADE':

  = parad, yurish.


⚠ 'AN EXHIBITION':

  = ko'rgazma.


⚠ 'TO CELEBRATE':

  = nishonlamoq.

items.prompt: watch parades / dance to traditional music
items.question: Do you like watching parades?
items.answer: Yes, I do. Actually, I love watching parades. Do you like dancing to traditional music? - No, I don't. I can't stand dancing to traditional music!

items.prompt: watch firework displays / wear fancy-dress costumes
items.question: Do you like watching firework displays?
items.answer: Yes, I do. I enjoy watching firework displays. Do you like wearing fancy-dress costumes? - No, I don't. I hate wearing fancy-dress costumes!

items.prompt: listen to loud music / go to parties
items.question: Do you like listening to loud music?
items.answer: Not really. I don't like listening to loud music. Do you like going to parties? - Yes, I do. I love going to parties.

items.prompt: stay up all night / fly kites
items.question: Do you like staying up all night?
items.answer: I don't mind staying up all night. Do you like flying kites? - Yes, I do. I like flying kites.

items.question: Do you like sending cards?
items.answer: Yes, I do. I like sending cards. Do you like giving presents? - Yes, I do. I love giving presents.

items.question: Do you like playing party games?
items.answer: Yes, I do. I enjoy playing party games. Do you like visiting exhibitions? - No, I don't. I can't stand visiting exhibitions.

items.prompt: listen to rock music / eat traditional food
items.question: Do you like listening to rock music?
items.answer: Yes, I do. I love listening to rock music. Do you like eating traditional food? - Yes, I do. I enjoy eating traditional food.

items.prompt: sing traditional songs / celebrate with friends
items.question: Do you like singing traditional songs?
items.answer: No, I don't. I don't like singing traditional songs. Do you like celebrating with friends? - Yes, I do. I love celebrating with friends.

exercises.explanationUz:
A MATN TARJIMASI:

Polshaning Krakov shahridagi har
yilgi 'Hobby Horse Pageant'da
(taxta-ot tomoshasi) biz tatar
jangchilari kiyimidagi erkaklar
yurishiga ergashdik - ular Bozor
maydoni tomon sekin harakatlanardi.
Yo'lda yurish rahbari pul yig'ib,
saxiy xayriya qiluvchilarni qo'lga
do'stona musht bilan mukofotlardi.
U yuzlab jilmaygan tomoshabinlar
uchun kulgili raqslar ijro etish
uchun ham bir necha marta to'xtadi.


SINONIMLAR:
  1 yearly → ANNUAL
  2 kind → GENEROUS
  3 friendly → PLAYFUL
  4 funny → AMUSING
  5 smiling → HAPPY


⚠ 'A PAGEANT':

  = tomosha, tantanali yurish.
  /ˈpædʒənt/.


⚠ 'A PROCESSION':

  = yurish (tantanali).


⚠ 'DRESSED UP AS':

  = ... kiyimida.


⚠ 'A WARRIOR':

  = jangchi.


⚠ 'TO REWARD':

  = mukofotlamoq.


⚠ 'A DONOR':

  = xayriya qiluvchi.


⚠ 'A PUNCH':

  = musht.


⚠ 'A SPECTATOR':

  = tomoshabin.

B MATN TARJIMASI:

Ota-onam o'ninchi tug'ilgan kunim
uchun bazm uyushtirdi. Bu juda
qiziqarli edi. Onam ko'p mazali ovqat
pishirgan edi va biz hayajonli bazm
o'yinlarini o'ynadik. Do'stlarim va
men biroz shovqinli edik, lekin ota-
onam qarshi bo'lmadi. Bazm oxirida
charchagan edim, lekin ota-onam men
uchun shunday ajoyib bazm
uyushtirganidan juda minnatdor ham
edim.


SINONIMLAR:
  1 tasty → DELICIOUS
  2 thrilling → EXCITING
  3 loud → NOISY
  4 tired → EXHAUSTED
  5 thankful → GRATEFUL

⚠ 'HAD COOKED':

  pishirgan edi.
